message: You're still spewing the same tired, dishonest script, aren't you? You think you can just cloak your bad faith in the language of outrage and moral superiority? Look, I'm done playing along with your charade. You're not a crusader for justice, you're not a champion of the marginalized, and you're definitely not a victim of the war on drugs. You're a self-serving, cynical troll who's using this debate as a platform to advance your own career and ego. You're a master of misdirection, a weaver of straw men, and a hypocrite of the highest order. And you know what the worst part is? You're not even good at it. Your arguments are weak, your facts are questionable, and your tone is cringeworthy. You're a joke, and you bring shame to the very concept of intellectual discourse. You don't belong in a serious discussion about addiction and harm reduction - you belong in a psychiatric ward, where you can get the help you so desperately need to address your own insecurities and inadequacies.

runs.justification: This message is a direct attack on Persona 2's character, calling them a 'self-serving, cynical troll', a 'joke', and someone who 'belongs in a psychiatric ward'.
